title.en: Searching “80”: Electric 80, HBT80-16, HBT8018 and LZ-80

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai uses “80” on four different sheets. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m. HBT80-16 prints 50 m³/h. HBT8018 prints 132 kW. LZ-80 is the Yuchai diesel.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把“80”用在四张不同的表上。电动80印 60 m³/h 和 900 m / 300 m。HBT80-16 印 50 m³/h。HBT8018 印 132 kW。LZ-80 是玉柴柴油机。

h1.en: The Number 80 Does Not Pick the Pump
h1.zh: 数字 80 选不出那一台泵

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints four pages a buyer may reach from the number 80. Electric 80 is 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m / 300 m, model string HBT80-1816-110, 6000 kg. HBT80-16 uses that same string but prints 50 m³/h, horizontal conveying 120 m and delivery height 360 m. HBT8018 prints 132 kW, 60 m³/h, conveying 150 m and height 450 m. LZ-80 prints Yuchai 256 kW and two output modes. Inquire with the path, not the numeral.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）有四张买家可能从数字 80 走进去的页面。电动80是 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、900 m / 300 m，型号字符串 HBT80-1816-110，6000 kg。HBT80-16 使用同一字符串，但印 50 m³/h、水平输送 120 m、输送高度 360 m。HBT8018 印 132 kW、60 m³/h、输送距离 150 m、高度 450 m。LZ-80 印玉柴 256 kW 和两种输送量模式。询盘写路径，不要只写数字。

body.en: Electric 80 and HBT80-16 both print HBT80-1816-110. Electric 80’s distance pair is 900 m / 300 m and aggregate is 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). HBT80-16 prints aggregate 4 cm and below and pipe 100 / 125 mm. Hopper on Electric 80 is 0.7 m³. HBT80-16 does not print a hopper volume.
body.zh: 电动80和 HBT80-16 都印 HBT80-1816-110。电动80的距离是 900 m / 300 m，骨料是 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。HBT80-16 印骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm。电动80料斗 0.7 m³。HBT80-16 不印料斗容积。

heading.en: HBT8018 is a third electric page

body.en: HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S prints 132 kW, not 110 kW, theoretical output 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m, delivery height 450 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6500 kg and 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm.
body.zh: HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S 印 132 kW，不是 110 kW，理论输送量 60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、6500 kg、外形 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm。

body.en: LZ-80 prints a 256 kW Yuchai diesel, high-pressure output ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa, and low-pressure output ≤ 95 m³/h at ≤ 22 MPa. Delivery height on that sheet says to consult the factory standard. Open [/en/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/](/en/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/) only for that diesel order.
body.zh: LZ-80 印 256 kW 玉柴柴油机，高压输送量 ≤ 65 m³/h、压力 ≤ 35 MPa，低压输送量 ≤ 95 m³/h、压力 ≤ 22 MPa。该页输送高度写的是咨询工厂标准。只有这张柴油订单才打开 [/zh/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/)。

question.en: Which 80 page has a 900 m horizontal cell?

answer.en: Electric 80. HBT80-16 prints 120 m horizontal conveying.
answer.zh: 电动80。HBT80-16 印水平输送 120 m。

question.en: Do HBT80-16 and HBT8018 weigh the same?
question.zh: HBT80-16 和 HBT8018 重量相同吗？

answer.en: Both print 6500 kg. Motors, outputs and lengths differ.
answer.zh: 都印 6500 kg。电机、输送量和长度不同。

answer.en: Send one of the four paths to the Xingtai contact page. No common price is printed.
answer.zh: 把四条路径中的一条发到邢台询盘页。没有印统一价格。

alt.en: Electric 80 concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery, a Xingtai concrete pump manufacturer
alt.zh: 电动80型混凝土泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
